title: Absorb the face factor 2 on the coefficient-9 approximant (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Under the same gate `p ≥ max(64, 4K + 2C)` and `16 g ceil(log2 p) ≤ p`,

```text
2 g (9 p^2 + p^6 exp(-p^2))^{g-1} p^6 exp(K p - p^2) < 2^{-C p}
```

for integers `p ≥ 2`, `g ≥ 1`, `K ≥ 0` and `C ≥ 0`. The approximant exponent without this factor is at most `-C p - 4`. The factor 2 is one bit, so the remaining slack is 3 and the exponent above is at most `-C p - 3`.

The base stays strictly below `16 p^2` because `p^6 exp(-p^2) < 1/2` for `p ≥ 64` and `9 p^2 + 1 < 16 p^2`. This does not identify HALO's `2g` rectangles with the tensor difference. The section ceiling and the section error stay hypotheses. At `g = p^2` the monomial is still greater than 1. No new κ. The selected record remains `23/10000`.

This answers the open question of #4497. It does not replay #4497. #4487 spends the same bit on the coefficient 10. One tensor axis is left open.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-tensor-nine-faces`
- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_TENSOR_NINE_FACES` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `2a13eb1827784206202db90e5dc8327cf8a250db`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetched at 2026-10-22T02:42:08Z was still that commit, and the pre-submit fetch was unchanged.
